description: This file defines a class 'UserPermission' within the 'Opencart\Admin\Controller\User' namespace. It manages user permission functionalities such as listing user groups, editing permissions, and form handling in the admin panel of OpenCart. The class extends a base controller and includes methods for index page, listing, form display, and internal permission list retrieval. It interacts with models, loads views, handles request parameters for sorting, pagination, and user group management.
